magnification $\times 2000$
Fig. 5.1

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State the evidence, **visible in Fig. 5.1**, that identifies the cells inside the capillary as red blood cells.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain how the structure of the capillary wall is related to its functions.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text:
An increase in respiration results in an increase in the carbon dioxide concentration in the blood and the release of more oxygen from red blood cells to tissues.

Explain how an increase in carbon dioxide in the blood leads to the release of more oxygen from red blood cells.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text:
Chloride ions are a constituent of blood plasma. The concentration of chloride ions in the plasma of deoxygenated blood is between $2\text{-}4 \text{mmol dm}^{-3}$ lower than in the plasma of oxygenated blood.

Explain why the concentration of chloride ions in the blood plasma of deoxygenated blood is lower than in the plasma of oxygenated blood.
